directive: Phase O(n) is EXCLUDED_FROM_PACKAGING and is NOT scored as a candidate. It appears only as a historical baseline the replacement must outperform or avoid.
scoring: Each criterion scored 1-5 (5 best). weighted_total = sum(weight_i * score_i). max = 5*100 = 500.

KDA_MLA_hybrid_KimiLinear.rationale: Open MIT 48B-A3B checkpoints (5.7T tokens), FLA+vLLM+SGLang kernels, channel-wise gated delta core, MLA preserves exact global path. Low differentiation (adopting public arch).

GatedDeltaNet_hybrid_Qwen3Next.rationale: Most mature/simplest; production-proven at scale (Qwen3-Next), easiest to train small, default vLLM/SGLang dispatch. Scalar (not channel-wise) gate; slightly weaker retrieval/binding.

GatedDeltaNet2_hybrid.rationale: LATEST; best reported recurrent retrieval + decoupled channel-wise erase/write (best correction/supersession). BUT single 1.3B evidence point, NO released checkpoints, NVIDIA NON-COMMERCIAL license (packaging blocker).

Mamba3_hybrid.rationale: Complex-valued MIMO SSM, half state/half decode cost, Apache. Weaker in-context recall/binding than delta family (no delta correction).

LightningAttention_hybrid_MiniMax.rationale: Open M1 hybrid, 1M ctx. Strike: MiniMax-M2 REVERTED to full attention citing production quality gap. Less standardized kernels.

Conventional_attention_hybrid_SWA_GQA_ML.rationale: Gold-standard quality/retrieval, ubiquitous kernels, trivially reproducible. NOT bounded state (KV grows); no efficiency differentiation. The conservative fallback (Candidate G) if no recurrent candidate passes evidence gates.

quality_first.note: KDA stays co-leader; conventional attention and GDN-2 rise; winner can shift to conventional (fully open) or GDN-2 (license-blocked).

efficiency_first.note: Conventional attention collapses (11/20, unbounded KV). KDA robust.

low_compute_first.note: GDN wins: reproducible, easiest to train small, default kernels. Favors GDN as the low-compute canonical starting point.

novelty_first.note: GDN-2 wins on novelty but is BLOCKED by non-commercial license + no checkpoints -> cannot be packaged. Novelty is not decisive.

enterprise_memory_first.note: Bounded-slot enterprise-memory sidecar becomes the differentiator over any open backbone; KDA remains top recurrent option.

verdict.canonical_sequence_mixer: Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) -- channel-wise gated delta-rule linear attention
verdict.fallback_1: Gated DeltaNet (SELECT_GATED_DELTANET_HYBRID) -- lower-risk, most mature, best low-compute score
verdict.fallback_2: Conventional attention hybrid (SELECT_CONVENTIONAL_ATTENTION_HYBRID) -- if no recurrent candidate passes evidence gates
verdict.gdn2_note: GDN-2 is the mechanism to ADOPT LATER once checkpoints/commercial license exist; its decoupled erase/write is the target capability, but its license and single-point evidence bar it from packaging now.
verdict.topology: Candidate C (KDA + periodic MLA, 3:1) as canonical core; extensible to Candidate E (+ bounded-slot enterprise-memory sidecar) ONLY if slots pass their independent thresholds.
verdict.full_attention_mechanism: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) as periodic global layer; GQA/SWA acceptable fallback
verdict.moe: OPTIONAL/DEFERRED -- first model dense; MoE is a scaling decision, not core
